verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that core Semgrep scanning runs locally without uploading code (semgrep-gh-2, semgrep-comm-11), but this is about local execution, not a stated policy on preventing AI training on user data. For Semgrep's AI-powered features (Assistant/AI-Powered Detection), there's no evidence of a training opt-out, data retention policy, or explicit AI-training exclusion clause.
